facts.fact: JJ 与 Emily 穿过 Merrion Centre 时抱怨 Alice 又提房租，坚称自己付过或交过押金。
facts.anchor: ‘Then she brings up the rent. Starts banging on about it, claiming I haven’t paid any, which is a lie, I’m sure I have, or I paid a deposit or something,’ said JJ as they walked through the Merrion Centre

facts.fact: Emily 说这地方让她想起自己的家。
facts.anchor: ‘This place is depressing. It reminds me of home.’

facts.fact: Emily 差点撞上来车，JJ 抓住她的阿富汗大衣把她拉回。
facts.anchor: She stepped out into the road and almost into the path of an oncoming van. JJ grabbed hold of her Afghan coat and pulled her back towards him.

facts.fact: JJ 心里认定 Emily 觉得世界欠她，和 Alice 完全不同。
facts.anchor: The girl seemed to think the world owed her. Not like Alice at all.

facts.fact: JJ 努力一年后，这学期终于挤进他向往的圈子。
facts.anchor: Finally, after a year of trying, he was starting to enjoy some success this term, inserting himself into desirable circles.

facts.fact: Emily 突然拉他进服装店，说看见不想见的人。
facts.anchor: ‘Just saw someone I don’t wanna see.’

facts.fact: 她解释那人是催她交论文的讲师。
facts.anchor: ‘Lecturer who keeps asking me for an essay I haven’t written.’

facts.fact: JJ 在 McDonald’s 问她新年夜是否留在利兹。
facts.anchor: ‘Have you made up your mind about New Year’s Eve yet? Will you be in Leeds?’

facts.fact: Emily 咬了一大口汉堡，慢慢嚼了几秒才耸耸肩回答。
facts.anchor: She took a huge bite of her burger and chewed it slowly for several seconds before answering with a shrug.

facts.fact: JJ 希望 Alice 不在，好用公寓办派对、结识新朋友。
facts.anchor: He hoped Alice would change her mind about spending New Year’s Eve in Leeds. In her absence, he could throw a party in the flat

facts.fact: JJ 冲出去与 Arthur 打招呼后，回来把桌上的钱包塞进大衣内袋。
facts.anchor: He grabbed his wallet from the table and shoved it firmly into the inside pocket of his coat.

facts.fact: 他认定不能信任 Emily，尤其不能信任她。
facts.anchor: He could not trust Emily Pierce. Could not trust anyone really, but especially not her.
